title: A survey and benchmark of high-dimensional Bayesian optimization of discrete sequences

layout.note: One big circle fills the figure; eight angular sectors, 13 concentric rings and pills in each sector; sector names run along the outer rim, the year labels along the vertical axis and the one-line OSS key sits at the lower right outside the disc.

lesson: Encode time and family in one picture: radius is the year, sector and pill colour are the family, and arrows give who builds on whom; pin a tiny badge to the pills that carry a property of interest and explain it in a one-glyph key.
